name: Aham Brahmasmi core
purpose: Keep durable user-owned state usable across different models, tools and runtimes.

quick.purpose: Use context that is already loaded while preserving all core rules.

regular.purpose: Load or verify current durable context before work begins.

degraded_offline.purpose: Continue cautiously with the last verified local state when fresh durable state cannot be reached.

wrap_up.purpose: Classify, validate and persist durable changes at session end using a replay-safe transaction.

unknown_runtime.behavior: Load the neutral core, state which capabilities are unavailable, use only verified readable context, and avoid writes unless write and validation capabilities are established.
